name: Candleguides
description: Wax-faced scarecrow guides born of village anxieties, which float in the witches' enclave.

timeline.summary: Arlinn finds the witches' enclave beneath an arch of the Celestus.
timeline.quote: she now sees an enclave: branches and hides fashioned into tents

pages_say.description: Wax-faced scarecrow guides born of village anxieties, which float in the witches' enclave.
Strange smiling spirits who point the way for the dead.
